_doc: Shared ordering fixture for supply_demand.explosive.explosive_key (backend) and compareExplosive (frontend/src/lib/bounceRoom.ts). Both suites sort `rows` and must produce `expected_no_signal` when MEASURED.status == 'no_signal' (fallback: intact first, then bounce_room.room_rank = CLEAR first, then ROOM/NEAR/IN_BAND by room_pct desc, then no-read; unknown reads ALWAYS last; symbol tiebreak) and `expected_separates` when status == 'separates' (score desc, unknown last, symbol tiebreak). Room blocks mirror bounce_room.room_read output. 2026-09-15.
_notes: separates: score desc (AAA/FFF tie 0.91 -> symbol), a null score counts as unknown-after-scored (HHH before the no-read EEE). no_signal: intact rows first — among them CLEAR (BBB) first, then room_pct desc (AAA 30 > FFF 12 > DDD 1.5 > HHH 0.0); then not-intact rows in the same room order (CCC CLEAR, GGG 8.0); no read (EEE) last.
